websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Websites to get the favicon and logo of, one per line. Domains (example.com) or full URLs. Up to 5,000 per run.

downloadImages.title: Download images
downloadImages.description: Save image files to the run's key-value store and add a download link to each row. "best" saves the best icon, the logo and the favicon; "all" saves every image found.

checkImages.title: Check every image
checkImages.description: Download each icon and logo to read its real file type and pixel size and drop broken links. Turn off for a faster run that trusts the sizes the page declares.

includeHeaderSvg.title: Include inline SVG logos
includeHeaderSvg.description: Many sites draw their header logo as inline SVG code instead of an image file. When on, such a logo is returned as a self-contained SVG data URI (and saved as an .svg file when downloading).

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel websites
maxConcurrency.description: How many websites to check at the same time.
